title: عمل فيديو من صوره
description: A mesmerizing, hyper-detailed time-lapse animation of a vibrant abstract painting being created from a completely blank canvas, matching Promo long.jpg exactly. The camera angle is static and aligned with the artwork. The scene starts with a pure blank white surface. First, the intricate geometric and patterned golden-yellow and orange background fills the canvas with precise brushstrokes and textures. Next, the outer decorative red and blue border with its geometric pattern materializes stroke by stroke. Then, the central main figure in the white robe with black star-studded panels, a blue face and turban, and a cane emerges gracefully. Finally, the lower red figure and all layered textural elements, overlapping shapes, and fine lines render smoothly into place. The final frame is a seamless, exact match to the complete finished artwork in Promo long.jpg, cinematic studio lighting, masterpiece quality.
